title: Quarterly portfolio tiling: mapping Hosted API endpoints to model rotation bursts
creator: Ana Martinez
description: Create a compact, operational roadmap artifact that tiles the quarter into ~6 sprint windows and maps each Hosted API endpoint cohort to a prioritized model rotation burst. Goal: reduce surprise capacity and model-quality regressions during seasonal demand while keeping per-token cost within budgeted lanes.
background: Recent spikes in search and chat traffic exposed mismatches between model choices and endpoint SLAs. Engineering telemetry shows increased tail latency for larger model variants during burst windows. PMs need a deterministic schedule for rotations, canaries, and fallbacks that product teams can opt into or opt out of per cohort.
goals: Define a rotation cadence (6 windows) tied to expected demand and cost targets
Provide per-endpoint recommended model cohorts and fallback mappings
Establish gating criteria (quality/regression/latency/cost) for each rotation
Ship an operational playbook and calendar for dev, infra, and solutions teams
acceptance_criteria: A CSV or owner-readable table exists mapping Hosted API endpoints -> primary model variant -> 2 compatible fallback variants
Rotation calendar published to product calendar with owners for each window
Automated smoke tests and quality gates defined and linked to the rotation entries
Cost projection (delta tokens * model unit cost) per rotation window documented and within 10% of finance target
checklist: Draft endpoint cohort definitions and thresholds (- by traffic, latency, importance)
Work with Research to supply model quality vectors for candidate variants
Align with Eng on capacity hedges and canary windows
Create rotation calendar artifact (ICS + Confluence playbook)
Define rollback triggers and SLA-driven fallback policy
Coordinate a dry run with staging traffic for one window
decisions: Adopt 6 rotation windows (bi-weekly burst mapping) to balance evaluation cadence and rollout risk
Limit primary variants to at most 2 larger models per endpoint cohort to control capacity
Require both a quality regression test and a latency budget check before any >10% traffic increase to a new variant
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model regression after swap -> Mitigation: pre-rotation A/B on 1% traffic + rollback script
Risk: Unexpected capacity contention -> Mitigation: reserve 15% burst buffer in Dedicated pools during rotation windows
Risk: Cost overshoot -> Mitigation: run projected cost simulation and set automatic throttles if delta exceeds threshold
